svg.text: OPTION B - connect to the ATX power using a 24-pin EXTENSION cable
Plug the PSU's 24-pin plug into the extension cable. Splice onto the extension cable's wires - never cut the PSU's own cable. The far end is not used.
strip ~5 mm of insulation from the middle
of the wire, wrap your new wire round it,
solder, cover with heat-shrink or tape.
OPTION B: green is NOT joined
Unplug the PSU from the wall before splicing. Go by wire COLOUR - you never need to count pins on a colour-coded cable.
